value.message: Validate and test your instance by conducting user acceptance testing (UAT). Verify with all key stakeholders that the system is performing properly after your production upgrade, and that key functionality is available.
• Assess the system holistically, including integration testing to make sure the units work together.
• Take a risk-based approach to determine what to test, starting with the most business-critical items.
• Identify your most business-critical processes, applications and unique configurations. Focus on testing these configurations and what is unique to your instance.
